name: gaming-backend
description: Gaming Arena backend services, APIs, service-to-service trust, and data boundaries.
objectives: Assess API authentication and authorization, tenant and account boundaries, object-level access, injection, SSRF, deserialization, and rate controls.
Trace high-value data paths and service-to-service trust assumptions through chained abuse cases.
Check input validation, error handling, secrets exposure, and security-relevant logging.
operational_constraints: Use only approved service endpoints and test identities.
Do not retrieve or retain real player records, payment data, or production secrets.
